correctness.rationale: The primary PDF was reconstructed at the control classes, factor controlled-frame definition, tensor controlled-frame definition, Theorem 4, and the full reverse proof. The one-dimensional real example satisfies every printed tensor hypothesis: all controls are bounded invertible, both factor energies equal the negative squared norm, and the tensor controls multiply to identities. Thus the tensor is Parseval while neither factor has a positive lower bound. The repaired reverse implication follows by dividing only after factor nonnegativity plus the tensor lower bound makes the denominator strictly positive.

value.rationale: Theorem 4 is the foundational if-and-only-if tensor-product characterization in the article. The failure occurs already in one real dimension with one block, so it is not a technical infinite-dimensional pathology. The repair pinpoints the exact logical defect in the proof—division by a nonzero quantity without sign control—and states a natural positivity condition under which the characterization becomes valid.
